meta.name: hunt-business-logic
meta.description: Hunting skill for business logic vulnerabilities. Built from 12 public bug bounty reports. Covers coupon-race-stacking (Instacart, Stripe, Reverb), negative-quantity-in-cart price tampering (Upserve, Eternal/Zomato), decimal/fraction price-field overflow (Shipt), client-side checkout amount trust on PayPal redirect (WordPress.org), price-per-unit mass-assignment (Krisp), and archived-price swap / cart-TOCTOU (Stripe). Use when hunting business logic — heavy emphasis on financial-impact-demonstrated cases.

copy.tagline: 发现业务逻辑漏洞，利用真实案例测试支付与价格缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做安全测试或漏洞赏金，需要业务逻辑漏洞案例与测试方法
copy.tagline_en: Find business logic vulnerabilities using real-world cases for payment and price flaws
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do security testing or bug bounty and need business logic vulnerability cases and testing methods

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你发现业务逻辑漏洞，比如价格篡改、优惠券重复使用、验证绕过等，并给出测试方法和攻击示例。
howto.when: 当你进行安全测试或漏洞挖掘，特别是涉及支付、验证、内部页面等业务逻辑时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个支付页面有没有价格篡改漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会给出拦截和修改支付请求的步骤。

say.text: 检查这个网站的验证流程能否被绕过。
say.note: Claude 会分析验证逻辑并提供绕过测试方法。

say.text: 这个内部页面是否需要认证才能访问？
say.note: Claude 会指导你如何发现未授权内部页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you find business logic vulnerabilities such as price tampering, coupon race conditions, verification bypasses, and provides testing methods and attack examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are performing security testing or bug hunting, especially involving payment, verification, internal pages, and other business logic.

say_en.text: Help me test this payment page for price tampering vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps to intercept and modify payment requests.

say_en.text: Check if this site's verification flow can be bypassed.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the verification logic and provide bypass testing methods.

say_en.text: Does this internal page require authentication to access?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you on how to discover unauthorized internal pages.
